about: The Editor's last Claude review (house style, facts, tone, premium visuals).
summary: Captions are clean on the Never list, but the Wild Nine post (2026-11-24-tue) falls short of the premium visual standard and is held; I could only see images for that one post.
points: 2026-11-24-tue card: the 'FREE · NO SIGN-UP' banner overlaps the in-game GolfPrice AI badge and hole panel, so the badge reads 'GolfPric' / 'GolfPrice Al' (cut off, overlapping). Fix: crop or mask the in-game HUD out of the screenshot, or move the banner clear of it.
2026-11-24-tue card and thumbnail: the game screenshot is soft and pixelated from upscaling (bushes, water edge, fairway). Fix: use a native-resolution capture or a clean rendered course graphic.

2026-11-24-tue card: 'WILD NINE' is jammed against the top edge, with its drop shadow nearly touching it, and the yellow banner bleeds off both sides. Fix: add safe margins of about 60px top and sides.

2026-11-24-tue thumbnail: raw app UI is cut off at the edges ('Island Green', 'Tee', '11 mph', 'hape', the Draw/Straight/Fade buttons, 'Drag back from anywhere...'). The tooltip 'Full Swing. Not full price.' sits above the title and mixes a price message into a free game. Fix: crop out the app chrome and the tooltip so only the course, 'WILD NINE' and one short line remain.

2026-11-24-tue thumbnail: the 4:5 grid crop would cut off the banner's 'FREE · NO SIGN-UP' strip and the product shot is cluttered. Fix: keep the title and the course in the middle 4:5 and make the course art larger and cleaner.

2026-11-24-tue: I couldn't extract video frames (no ffmpeg in this environment), so pace and cuts are not reviewed. Re-check the three frames for the same HUD cut-off and low-res problems after the fix.
2026-11-24-tue caption: '1 in 10,000' for a hole in one on Hole 10 should come from the game's own data. Confirm that before it goes out.
2026-11-25-wed and 2026-12-02-wed: X and Bluesky text starts the link with a capital 'Https://', which breaks the link. Fix: lower-case 'https://'.
All other posts (2026-11-26 to 2026-12-06): no images were supplied, so the visual standard was not checked. Captions are fine, with #Ad on product posts and no retailer names or fake urgency.
2026-11-27-fri and 2026-12-04-fri: the captions have no product, but they end with the #golfdeals #golfgear tag set. Consider dropping those tags (minor).
2026-11-26-thu and 2026-11-28-sat: the PowaKaddy and Callaway product photos were not provided, so I can't confirm the right product is shown.
